title: 2 Chronicles Bible Quiz - Chapter 36
description: Ten questions on 2 Chronicles 36: the last kings of Judah, the fall of Jerusalem, and the proclamation of Cyrus king of Persia.

questions.text: How long did Joahaz reign in Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Joahaz was twenty-three years old when he began to reign, and he reigned three months in Jerusalem.

questions.text: What new name did the king of Egypt give to Eliakim?
questions.explanation: The king of Egypt made Eliakim king over Judah and Jerusalem, and changed his name to Jehoiakim.

questions.text: Where did Nebuchadnezzar put some of the vessels of Yahweh's house?
questions.explanation: Nebuchadnezzar carried some of the vessels of Yahweh's house to Babylon, and put them in his temple at Babylon.

answers.text: In the house of Baal in Samaria

questions.text: How old was Jehoiachin when he began to reign?
questions.explanation: Jehoiachin was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned three months and ten days in Jerusalem.

questions.text: Before which prophet did Zedekiah not humble himself?
questions.explanation: Zedekiah didn't humble himself before Jeremiah the prophet speaking from Yahweh's mouth.

questions.text: How did the people treat the messengers Yahweh sent to them?
questions.explanation: They mocked the messengers of God, despised his words, and scoffed at his prophets, until there was no remedy.

answers.text: They listened and turned back to Yahweh
They made them rulers over the city
They mocked them and scoffed at his prophets
They hid them from the king

questions.text: Whom did Yahweh bring on them?
questions.explanation: Yahweh brought on them the king of the Chaldeans, who killed their young men with the sword in the house of their sanctuary.

questions.text: What happened to God's house in Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: They burned God's house, broke down the wall of Jerusalem, and burned all its palaces with fire.

answers.text: It was turned into a palace
It was carried stone by stone to Babylon

questions.text: How many years did the desolate land keep Sabbath, to fulfill Yahweh's word by Jeremiah?
questions.explanation: As long as the land lay desolate, it kept Sabbath, to fulfill seventy years.

questions.text: According to Cyrus king of Persia, what had Yahweh commanded him to do?
questions.explanation: Cyrus said that Yahweh, the God of heaven, had commanded him to build him a house in Jerusalem, which is in Judah.

answers.text: To destroy the city of Babylon
To rebuild the walls of Samaria
To build him a house in Jerusalem
To bring the ark back from Egypt
